newsitem.title: USA: EPIX, Mallinckrodt begin new tests.
newsitem.headline: EPIX, Mallinckrodt begin new tests.

text.p: EPIX Medical Inc and Mallinckrodt Inc said Friday they have begun a Phase II clinical trial of EPIX's injectable magnetic resonance imaging contrasting agent, MS-325.
The companies said MS-325 is designed for multiple cardiovascular indications.
The trial is being conducted at several sites and will involve the participation of about 75 patients, they said.
An initial phase I trial on 35 test subjects was completed in the first quarter and produced no clinically significant side effects, the companies said.
